name: Tempest-Forged Chains OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-14: Shattering Golden Chains
description: Brightly polished copper chains rumble with distant thunder and statically charge the air.
disable: DC 30 Thievery (expert) to release the lock, or DC 27 Arcana or DC 27 Nature (expert) to harmlessly release the storm's energy

generalAbilities.name: Storm's Rage
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature attempts to break or escape the chains

Effect The chains release a devastating blast of lightning that deals (4d10+18) Electricity Damage damage to all creatures in the room. Affected creatures must each attempt a DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and becomes Deafened for 1 minute.

Failure The creature takes full damage and becomes deafened for 1 hour.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage. It also becomes deafened for 8 hours.
